description: This file defines a Catalyst controller for managing 'terms' in an admin interface, including actions for listing, creating, editing, updating, and deleting terms, with access control and URL routing.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Admin::Terms
classes.description: Controller class for managing terms in the admin interface, handling CRUD operations and URL routing.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles GET and HEAD requests to list all terms, generating URLs for viewing, editing, and deleting each term.

methods.name: new_terms
methods.description: Handles GET and HEAD requests to initialize a new term with a default 'valid_from' date, then delegates to 'edit' for rendering.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Captures a term by ID for subsequent actions, or detaches with an error if not found.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a term if it is not marked to be kept, then redirects to index.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Prepares the form for editing or creating a term, setting the submission URL and template.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update an existing term or delegate to create if new.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new term and then delegate to update_or_create.

methods.name: update_or_create
methods.description: Private method to save a term's data from request parameters, inserting or updating as needed.
